def load() -> pd.DataFrame:
    import pandas as pd

    path = "data/legal/input/csn-data-book-2024-csv/CSVs/2024_CSN_State_Identity_Theft_Reports.csv"

    # The file has a title row then a blank row then the real header on row index 2.
    df = pd.read_csv(path, skiprows=2, header=0, encoding_errors="ignore")

    # Drop blank/footer rows
    first_col = df.columns[0]
    df = df[df[first_col].notna()].copy()

    # Normalize column names
    df.columns = [str(c).strip() for c in df.columns]

    # Strip key string fields
    if "State" in df.columns:
        df["State"] = df["State"].astype(str).str.strip()
    if "Theft Type" in df.columns:
        df["Theft Type"] = df["Theft Type"].astype(str).str.strip()

    # Parse numeric reports
    if "# of Reports" in df.columns:
        df["# of Reports"] = pd.to_numeric(
            df["# of Reports"].astype(str).str.replace(",", "", regex=False),
            errors="coerce",
        )

    return df

def process(alIdentityTheft2024) -> pd.DataFrame:
    import pandas as pd

    df = alIdentityTheft2024.copy()

    # Keep only Alabama rows with a valid numeric report count
    mask = (df["State"] == "Alabama") & (df["# of Reports"].notna())
    total = float(df.loc[mask, "# of Reports"].sum())

    return pd.DataFrame([{"total_reports": int(round(total))}])
